steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the buyer to add the vendor during event creation.
Provide the required event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required item for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA test vendor to both stages.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal in a separate session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Verify the first technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Have the vendor accept the first mandatory clause.
Have the vendor accept the second mandatory clause.
Submit the vendor's technical response after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the technical response was submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage as the vendor.
Verify the Technical-stage clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second Technical-stage clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Submit a quote of 100 for the RFQ line.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's RFQ response.
